name: Civitel Attik Rooms & Suites
description: Civitel Attik is a contemporary hotel in Marousi, Athens, conveniently located near OAKA (Athens Olympic Stadium), HELEXPO Marousi, Golden Hall and The Mall Athens. Designed to accommodate both business and leisure travelers, the hotel offers a range of room categories suitable for corporate stays, conference guests and families. All rooms feature marble bathrooms with walk-in rain showers, complimentary minibar, high-speed Wi-Fi, refillable bathroom amenities and recycling facilities. Depending on the room category, guests can also enjoy a private balcony or ground-floor patio, a comfortable seating area, a dedicated workspace and convenient charging stations. With easy access to the Athens business district and major transport links, Civitel Attik provides a comfortable and practical base for business trips, events and city stays in the northern suburbs of Athens.
